blocks.text: Specific heat capacity woh garmi (calories mein) hai jo kisi cheez ke 1 gram ka temperature 15 °C se 16 °C, yani 1 °C, barhane ke liye chahiye. Pani ki specific heat capacity zyada hai: 4.184 joules (yani 1 gram pani ko 1 °C garam karne ke liye 4.184 J ya 1 calorie chahiye). Is ka matlab hai ke pani apna temperature bohat kam badle baghair bohat si garmi jazb (absorb) bhi kar sakta hai aur chhor bhi sakta hai. Pani jo garmi jazb karta hai us ka zyada hissa molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds torne mein kharch hota hai. Bonds tootne ke baad molecules zyada azadi se harkat karne lagte hain aur tab pani ka temperature barhta hai.
Pani ki specific heat zyada tar carbon compounds se do guna aur iron (loha) se nau guna zyada hai.

Specific heat zyada hone ki wajah se pani aahista garam hota hai. Isi tarah thande mahol mein bhi yeh apna temperature der tak qaim rakhta hai. Is tarah pani jandaron ke andar ke mahol aur bahar ke mahol dono ke temperature ko stable (ek jaisa) rakhta hai.
